payload.text: 0190, parallel test runs (vc's assignment on hv's go, ahead of the 0.1.10 cut). v1.1 is built in scratch: rb190 branch b190 at 56740cf1, 6 commits on 0191's 542711c1. The suite runs in two lanes: bats --jobs N where GNU parallel is installed, then the tests tagged serial one at a time, one verdict, the count held against an untagged bats --count. N is half the CPUs and DEVBIN_TEST_JOBS sets it; the run is serial as before without GNU parallel or at N=1, and its first line says why. The two-lane BSD suite is GREEN: 627.0 s, 2294 of 2294, against 40.6 min serial. The GNU suite is in flight on vc's START, and the box takes one heavy run at a time between dc and cc until 0191, 0192 and 0190 land. On its END: END to vc AND cc (cc's START for 0192), then the handover to vc, rebased onto cc's 0191 v1.1, or 2b719467 until that exists. State: ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/STATE.md.
